Translating the equations (2)-(3) and the physical reasoning into code requires genuine understanding of the method and non-trivial math.
rationale.execution: The pipeline includes implementing a forward model, fitting parameters using an optimizer, and producing three output artifacts. It has several sequential stages (about 5 defined steps) with dependencies, requiring orchestration of model code, a fitting loop, and output generation. While not extremely fragile, it is more than a simple script.
